title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Researcher agent for GCC users
summary: Hold: the briefing mistakes GCC for the Microsoft Graph US Government L4 deployment when assessing blocking automation; GCC uses the worldwide Graph service. The web-search route also mixes creation and editing steps, its automation cannot govern group policies, and Microsoft documents an alternative to the claimed sole blocking switch.
